title: QUIZ - 05
description: Test your knowledge, strengthen your reasoning, and learn something new with every question.

questions.learningObjective: Evaluate multi-step expressions containing parentheses, multiplication, and subtraction
questions.question: Evaluate: \( (5 + 2) \times 9 - 9 \)
questions.explanation: Parentheses first: 5 + 2 = 7. Then multiply: \(7 \times 9 = 63\). Finally subtract: 63 - 9 = 54.
questions.hint: Simplify inside parentheses first, then multiply/divide, then add/subtract.

questions.learningObjective: Evaluate expressions combining parentheses, multiplication, and division in the correct sequence
questions.question: Evaluate: \( 4 + 9 \times ( 9 - 2 ) \div 1 \)
questions.explanation: Work inside the parentheses first: 9 - 2 = 7. Next, multiplication and division from left to right: \(9 \times 7 = 63\), then \(63 \div 1 = 63\). Finally, 4 + 63 = 67.
questions.hint: Resolve parentheses, then multiplication/division left to right, then addition/subtraction.

questions.hint: Resolve parentheses, then multiplication/division left to right, then addition/subtraction.

questions.learningObjective: Evaluate expressions by applying multiplication before addition
questions.question: Evaluate: \( 10 + 5 \times 6 \)
questions.explanation: Multiplication is performed before addition. First, \(5 \times 6 = 30\). Then, 10 + 30 = 40.
questions.hint: Perform multiplication and division before addition and subtraction (PEMDAS).
